ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. happiness
   C. quickly
   D. run

2. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

3. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. No full stops

4. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goed
   C. goes
   D. went

5. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library

6. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a joining word

7. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

8. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.

9. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.

10. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.

11. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.

12. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

13. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.

14. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
